style_notes: SYSTEM SEOUL-adjacent reference is high-level texture only

sections.name: intro_hook_hint
instructions: Introduce the new lead motif immediately.
Use filtered sample/synth motif.
Avoid long AI intro.
Push vocal texture back or replace it with synth/sample lead.
Use the strongest sample motif only if ownership/clearance allows direct use.

sections.name: main_hook
instructions: Full drums/808 enter.
Lead melody becomes central.
Vocal texture must not dominate lead.
Add wide upper synth layer, sub stays mono.
Push vocal texture back or replace it with synth/sample lead.
Use the strongest sample motif only if ownership/clearance allows direct use.

sections.name: verse_groove
instructions: Reduce lead density but keep motif fragments audible.
Use one call-response phrase.
Remove repeated AI loop blocks.
Push vocal texture back or replace it with synth/sample lead.
Use the strongest sample motif only if ownership/clearance allows direct use.

sections.name: hook_return
instructions: Return to the same hook identity.
Add one controlled variation, not a new random idea.
Keep transition clean and intentional.
Push vocal texture back or replace it with synth/sample lead.
Use the strongest sample motif only if ownership/clearance allows direct use.

sections.name: breakdown_filtered_lead
instructions: Filter the lead or sample motif.
Push weird vocal texture behind the motif.
Do not add random risers unless they announce the final hook.
Push vocal texture back or replace it with synth/sample lead.
Use the strongest sample motif only if ownership/clearance allows direct use.

sections.name: final_hook
instructions: Bring back full hook with final lift.
Use stronger drums/808 without masking lead.
Resolve sample/synth motif clearly.
Push vocal texture back or replace it with synth/sample lead.
Use the strongest sample motif only if ownership/clearance allows direct use.

sections.name: clean_outro_or_loop
instructions: End quickly or make a loopable ending.
Avoid dead outro.
Do not extend generated material.
Push vocal texture back or replace it with synth/sample lead.
Use the strongest sample motif only if ownership/clearance allows direct use.

hook_identity_plan.lead_source: preserve and simplify strongest existing motif
hook_identity_plan.hook_source: reuse detected hook with tighter repetition
motif_rules: Repeat one main motif in every hook.
Create one call-response phrase for verse or hook answer.
Do not copy exact melodies, samples, lyrics, drum patterns, basslines, or artist vocal identities.
hook_identity_plan.vocal_texture_rule: push back or replace with synth/sample lead
hook_qc: Hook is recognizable with drums muted.
Hook appears before 15 seconds for short-form modes.
Hook return clearly references the first hook.

remove_or_reduce: decorative fills that do not support hook
manual_logic_required: True stem-level rewrite requires stems or manual Logic editing.
New lead MIDI/synth may need manual confirmation.
Stereo-only rescue cannot claim vocal removal, kick replacement, 808 rewrite, or drum rewrite.
rules: Do not keep 3-minute weak AI structure by default.
If no lead exists, plan a new lead.
If vocal texture is weird, push it back or replace with synth/sample lead.
Reference style is broad production direction only.
